name: Miscreant
storyline:
You play as Soot. He’s got sharp wits, quick hands, and a complete disregard for the rules. When he swipes a coin pouch from Mr. E., the enigmatic Rogue Studies professor, he falls right into a trap. But instead of a jail cell, Soot gets an invitation to Vanderute Academy, a prestigious school for adventurers.

Now, he must pose as the academy’s newest rogue pupil while secretly collecting mysterious keys to open a legendary vault under the school.
summary: Miscreant is an action-adventure with a focus on stealth, puzzles, and exploration. You play a rogue-in-training, exploring your school after curfew to complete a daring assignment: Break into the the legendary vault under the school.
